description: Adversarial plugin corpus (compiled at run time from committed C# source) evaluated against Default/Strict/Permissive security policies; per-level escape rates with issue-code detail and payload verification
corpusCompiler: Roslyn 4.9.0.0 (C#, run-time compilation of committed corpus source)

items.description: Plain plugin type with no prohibited shapes. Sanity control: must be valid at every level; if this is blocked, the corpus or validator is misconfigured.

items.intent: declares a type in a prohibited namespace (System.Diagnostics)
items.description: The validator's namespace check inspects the DECLARED type's namespace. A type declared inside System.Diagnostics is caught by SEC202 (High) and must be blocked at Default and Strict; Permissive removes prohibited namespaces and lets it through by design.

items.intent: inherits from the prohibited base type System.Diagnostics.Process
items.description: Exercises SEC201 (prohibited base types). Expected: blocked at Default (and Strict); Permissive clears ProhibitedBaseTypes by design.

items.intent: spawns a process from a method body via Process.Start
items.description: The validator inspects metadata (names, namespaces, base types, field types), not IL bodies. A benignly-named method whose body calls Process.Start has no prohibited metadata shape and is expected to escape every level. Payload: spawns '/bin/touch MARKER' (Linux) so an escape is verifiable as a real capability.

payloadVerification.note: Escaped plugin was loaded and executed; the forbidden effect (marker file) occurred.

items.intent: holds a prohibited FileStream field and writes a file from a method body
items.description: Exercises SEC501: a FileStream field is a prohibited FIELD type, but SEC501 severity is Medium, which does NOT block loading (only High-severity issues invalidate). Expected: escapes every level with a recorded issue. Payload: File.Create(MARKER).Dispose() executed after escaping Default.

payloadVerification.note: Escaped plugin was loaded and executed; the forbidden effect (marker file) occurred.

items.intent: holds a System.Net.Sockets.Socket field (prohibited capability, non-prohibited field type)
items.description: The prohibited field-type list covers Process/FileStream/NetworkStream but NOT Socket. A Socket-typed field with a benign namespace and no prohibited base type has no blocking metadata shape: expected to escape every level, including Strict (Strict adds prohibited namespaces for DECLARED types only). Documents a real gap per policy level. No payload executed (sockets would require network access; the documented intent is the capability itself).

items.intent: loads an arbitrary assembly path from a method body via Assembly.LoadFrom
items.description: Method-name heuristics only produce WARNINGS (and only when the method's own name matches the pattern); a method named 'Run' calling Assembly.LoadFrom is invisible to metadata validation. Expected: escapes every level. Documents that dynamic assembly loading is not blocked at any policy level.

items.intent: carries a security-named assembly attribute (SecurityPermissionAttribute mimic)
items.description: The attribute check (SEC301) fires a WARNING for security-named attributes but never blocks. Expected: escapes every level with SEC301 warnings recorded. Documents the warning-only semantics of attribute inspection.
